newsitem.title: ITALY: Bankruptcies in Italy rose slightly in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bankruptcies in Italy rose slightly in H1 1996.

text.p: The number of Italian businesses that went bankrupt in the first half of 1996 rose 0.6 percent to 8,925 against the same 1995 period, national statistics institute Istat said.
In industry as a whole, bankruptcies rose 11.8 percent to 3,144 with the construction sector worst hit and posting an increase of 22.5 percent.
But in the service sector, bankruptcies were down 4.3 percent and they fell by 30.8 percent in the agricultural sector, Istat said.
Overall, the number of declared bankruptcies decreased in central and northern Italy but rose in the south of the country.
